headline: Working group updates on meadow management, lawn rewilding, and human-wildlife interactions, plus invasive species and a library Join Fair.
summary: The agenda covers invasive species management and a free movie and Join Fair at the South Burlington Public Library on November 15. It also includes a UVM Vermont Climate Assessment item and working group updates.

Discuss "Join Fair" hosted by SB Public Library 
You are invited to a free movie and "Join Fair" at the South Burlington Public Library. On 
Sunday, November 15, the library and SB Recreation & Parks are partnering to host a 
free screening of the movie JOIN OR DIE — about the importance of engaging with and 
investing in your community through volunteering and participating in civic and community 
groups.
The 93-minute film starts at 1:00. The fair runs 2:30-3:30pm. This event will be held in the 
library auditorium and in the SB Public Art Gallery.  Rec would provide you with a 6 -foot 
table, chairs, and any power needed.
